title: A Level-15 Certificate for the Prime-29 Gate in the Fifteen-Runner Lonely Runner Problem
description: Technical report, exact certificate data, and verification software proving J(14,29) is empty. The unique level-one improper orbit is reduced at level 15 to coprime and noncoprime symmetry branches. Two independently written exact solvers exclude all thirteen coprime coordinate-zero cases. A 210-variable, 1,842-clause CNF and a DRAT proof accepted by DRAT-trim and rate exclude the noncoprime branch. The result closes the prime-29 finite-checking gate for fifteen total runners. It contributes log(29) to the required prime mass and does not prove the full fifteen-runner Lonely Runner Conjecture.
